decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint is core to the firm's pipeline-fitting business and uses its existing welding and coating capacity, so it stays as part of the range the firm has publicly announced.
The pipe bracket has its own page, was a visible commitment to range expansion, and builds on established capabilities, so weak results can still be put down to project ramp-up times.

The public waste bin is far from the core business, but the firm invested in a dedicated page and powder-coating capacity, and pandemic-related delays in municipal spending give a temporary explanation for weak results.

As a multi-model line that justifies the move into street furniture, the waste bin with ashtray carries substantial sunk investment and a public commitment, so management persists despite uncertain demand.
The outdoor ashtray line shares the coating investment and the same municipal customer base as the bins, and dropping it would undercut the diversification the firm justified only recently.
